## Frame kinds

- [Layout](symbols/frames/layout.md) (`layout`) — Flex-like container: direction, gap, padding, layers, sizing.
- [Text](symbols/frames/text.md) (`text`) — Typography + optional typeStyle; optional editable root with EditableText.
- [Icon](symbols/frames/icon.md) (`icon`) — Small tintable symbol frame.
- [Media](symbols/frames/media.md) (`media`) — Raster / vector / video drawable box.
